status_label: BNPB preliminary update at 15:00 WIB — verification and validation continue

source.title: Official BNPB press conference: 15:00 WIB update on conditions and response

displacement.location: Affected areas in East Nusa Tenggara

confirmed: 38 deaths reported by BNPB: 3 in Sikka, 16 in Manggarai, 17 in East Manggarai, 1 in Ende and 1 in West Manggarai; identification and verification continue.
13 injured people: 2 seriously injured and 11 with minor injuries.
Approximately 2,000 people undertook evacuation or self-evacuation.
The first-day casualty and affected-population figures remain subject to continuing field reconciliation.
damage_reports: Detailed sectoral damage counts remain based on the earlier 12:30 WIB BNPB update: 54 houses heavily damaged, 9 moderately damaged and 11 slightly damaged.
Five health facilities and one education facility were reported damaged in Manggarai; facility-level verification continues.
One Bulog warehouse, three places of worship and six government offices were reported affected.
Transport, road, electricity and telecommunications disruptions are being assessed separately by the responsible agencies.
information_gaps: Consolidated missing-person, trapped-person and affected-population figures by district.
Reconciled casualty records across BNPB, BPBD, Basarnas and district authorities.
Verified WASH, electricity, telecommunications, road and transport-service restoration status by district.
Post-disaster public-health and animal-health surveillance data.
Official monetary estimates of physical damage, economic loss and livelihood disruption.
disclaimer: All figures remain preliminary and may change following further verification and validation by BNPB, BPBD and relevant authorities.
